To reset your password, go to Settings > Security and click Reset Password. A reset link will be emailed to you and expires in one hour. 

If you're not receiving the email, please check your spam/junk folder. If the reset link shows an error when you click it, it has likely expired - simply request a fresh one by going through the reset process again.

Note that password reset is only available on the web version of our product.
